title: Strixwolf Pup One
hook: Player-safe note: A wet-feathered strixwolf pup with oversized ears, bright frightened eyes, and paws too large for the body it has not grown into yet.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Young owl-wolf body, mottled fur, downy dark wing-feathers along the back, upright ears, and cautious forward posture.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Pure startled instinct in a body it has not grown into yet. Bright frightened eyes, ears that swivel at every snapped twig, paws a size too big. It wants its mother and cannot understand why the road brought strangers instead.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Loud voices, hands that reach too fast, and the open ground between itself and its mother.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
